newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ says to maintain easy monetary policy.
newsitem.headline: BOJ says to maintain easy monetary policy.

text.p: Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita said on Friday that the central bank will maintain its current easy monetary policy to help achieve sustainable economic growth.

Matsushita told the Upper House of parliament's budget committee that the BOJ was monitoring economic conditions, including "various market moves". He did not specify what markets he was referring to.
"We will maintain the current accommodative monetary policy to make firmer the basis for economic recovery," he said.
The Japanese economy is recovering gradually, and the BOJ can now detect a firmness in economic activities, he said.
"However, we are now watching the economy to see if the easy monetary policy will have more, clearer effects on the economy," he said.
